# Beta 多样性分析

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: beta-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
source("figure-notes.R")
```

## 构建 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: beta-create-microtable
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
```

## 计算 Beta 多样性指标

```{r}
#| label: calc-beta
mt$cal_betadiv()

plot_group_distance_box = function(trans_obj, group_var) {
    plot_data = trans_obj$res_group_distance
    names(plot_data)[names(plot_data) != "Value"] = "group"
    plot_data |>
        ggplot(aes(x = group, y = Value, fill = group)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.18, size = 1, alpha = 0.45) +
        labs(x = group_var, y = "Bray-Curtis distance") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

## PCoA 分析

### 按品种比较

```{r}
#| label: fig-pcoa-by-breed
#| fig-cap: "基于 Bray-Curtis 距离的 PCoA 分析，按品种着色。"
t1 = trans_beta$new(dataset = mt, group = "breed", measure = "bray")
t1$cal_ordination(method = "PCoA")
t1$plot_ordination(plot_color = "breed", plot_type = c("point", "ellipse")) +
    theme_bw()
```


```{r}
#| label: note-pcoa-by-breed
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("pcoa-by-breed")
```

### 按基因型比较

```{r}
#| label: fig-pcoa-by-genotype
#| fig-cap: "基于 Bray-Curtis 距离的 PCoA 分析，按基因型着色。"
t1$plot_ordination(plot_color = "genotype", plot_type = c("point", "ellipse")) +
    theme_bw()
```


```{r}
#| label: note-pcoa-by-genotype
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("pcoa-by-genotype")
```

## 组内距离分析

```{r}
#| label: fig-within-group-distance-breed
#| fig-cap: "不同品种组内的 Bray-Curtis 距离分布。"
t1 = trans_beta$new(dataset = mt, group = "breed", measure = "bray")
t1$cal_group_distance(within_group = TRUE)
t1$cal_group_distance_diff(method = "wilcox")
plot_group_distance_box(t1, "breed")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-within-group-distance-breed
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("within-group-distance-breed")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-within-group-distance-genotype
#| fig-cap: "不同基因型组内的 Bray-Curtis 距离分布。"

t1$cal_group_distance(within_group = TRUE)
t1$cal_group_distance_diff(method = "wilcox")
plot_group_distance_box(t1, "genotype")
```
